title: Isolation Demo Dockerfile
description: Dockerfile for Oh My Pi coding agent on Debian with Bun, pinned by digest, configured for non-root user and workspace mount.

steps.description: Complete Dockerfile for the isolation demo.
Base image: Debian + Bun 1.4.4 pinned by SHA256 digest for reproducibility.
Root user setup: USER root for package installation and system configuration.
Apt cleanup: update, install ca-certificates and curl, remove apt lists to minimize image size.
Oh My Pi installation: BUN_INSTALL=/opt/omp, global install, symlink to /usr/local/bin/omp, permissions fix.
User configuration: chmod 711 on /home, mkdir /workspace, chown to bun user, USER bun, HOME env, WORKDIR.
